request.style: English, male solo voice, warm and earnest, acoustic guitar, cello, soft percussion, handpan, gentle folk ballad, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
From Gilgal we walked side by side
Elijah said stay here, I must go
But I swore I would not leave his side
As surely as the Lord lives, no

[Chorus]
Give me a double portion of your spirit
Before you are taken from my sight
If I see you go, it shall be given
If not, then let me be in the night

[Verse]
At Bethel the prophets asked me then
Do you know he is being taken away?
I said yes, I know, be still, my friend
And we kept walking through the day

[Chorus]
Give me a double portion of your spirit
Before you are taken from my sight
If I see you go, it shall be given
If not, then let me be in the night

[Pre-Chorus]
At the Jordan river bank we stood
Fifty prophets watched us from afar
He rolled up his cloak, striking the flood
The water parted on the dry ground star

[Chorus]
Give me a double portion of your spirit
Before you are taken from my sight
If I see you go, it shall be given
If not, then let me be in the night

[Bridge]
A chariot of fire split the sky
Horses of flame and a whirlwind sound
Elijah rose up, I cried and I sighed
My father, the chariots of this ground

[Outro]
I took his cloak and struck the water
The Jordan split to the right and left
The spirit of Elijah is the answer
The God of Elijah is what I sought
